findings.summary: Governance page shows Actual spend = $0.00 while Cost page shows Estimated spend = $286.27 — budget tracking is disconnected from real token spend; enforcement guardrails would never trigger at the correct threshold; budget shows 0% used when ~28.6% should be consumed.
findings.evidence: screenshots/06-governance-page.png (Actual spend $0.00, Forecasted $0.07) vs screenshots/04-costs-page.png ($286.27 estimated spend). Monthly budget = $1000.
findings.suspected_source: Governance uses AWS Budgets billing-cycle actual spend; Cost page derives estimates from CloudWatch token metrics × pricing. Different data sources with no reconciliation shown to user.

findings.summary: Quota headroom section renders badge '✓ No throttling' immediately adjacent to 'client errors (24h): 66' — directly contradictory messaging confuses operators about system health.
findings.evidence: screenshots/08-usage-quota-section.png — HTML: ✓ No throttling client errors (24h): 66
findings.suspected_source: Usage page quota badge logic only checks HTTP 429 throttle errors; the client error count (66) includes all 4xx errors. Badge text should read 'No 429s' or the count label should clarify error type.

findings.summary: Token count 7.1× discrepancy: Usage KPI shows ~457k total tokens (10.8k input + 446.3k output) while Projects page shows 3.25M total tokens and Cost table sums to ~3.33M — no consistent time-window label across pages.
findings.evidence: screenshots/03-usage-page.png (10.8k in / 446.3k out) vs screenshots/05-projects-page.png (3.25M total). Usage says 'across window' with no date range shown.
findings.suspected_source: Usage page likely uses a narrow rolling window (e.g. 1-hour or last N buckets) while Projects and Cost use a broader window (e.g. 24h or 7-day). Window scope is not displayed.

findings.summary: Estimated spend mismatch: Cost page $286.27 vs Projects page (DynamoDB) $346.70 — $60.43 (21.1%) discrepancy between two pages that should show the same total spend.
findings.evidence: screenshots/04-costs-page.png (KPI: $286.27 current window) vs screenshots/05-projects-page.png (KPI: $346.70 total est. cost)
findings.suspected_source: Different aggregation sources: Cost page uses CloudWatch per-model metrics with price lookup; Projects uses DynamoDB attribution. Untagged traffic cost may be double-counted or computed differently.

findings.summary: Three model IDs appear as duplicate rows in the spend table: 'global.anthropic.claude-fable-5' ×2, 'us.anthropic.claude-fable-5' ×2, 'us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8' ×2 (16 rows for ~13 distinct models). Second occurrences show $0.00 but some have non-zero token counts.
findings.evidence: screenshots/04-costs-page.png — HTML table contains 16 tbody rows with repeated model IDs; second us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8 row has 9 input + 16 output tokens at $0.00
findings.suspected_source: Cost data API returns duplicate records (possibly different regional/global endpoint variants); deduplication not applied in frontend or backend data pipeline.

findings.summary: Token consumption chart X-axis has an out-of-order label: after '05:00' the next label is '04:00' (going backwards) before jumping to '09:00' — breaks time continuity and makes chart untrustworthy.
findings.evidence: screenshots/03-usage-page.png — X-axis tick sequence at positions 10–13: ...04:00, 05:00, 04:00, 09:00... (04:00 duplicated, 06:00/07:00/08:00 missing)
findings.suspected_source: Time-bucket sort order bug in chart data preparation; timestamps not normalized to full ISO datetime before sorting, or a data record has a corrupted/duplicate timestamp.

findings.summary: Model 'us.anthropic.claude-fable-5' shows 220,634 input + 782,832 output + 103.04M cache-read tokens but computes to $0.00 estimated cost — pricing lookup fails for this model ID, causing material cost underreporting.
findings.evidence: screenshots/04-costs-page.png — table row: us.anthropic.claude-fable-5 | 220,634 | 782,832 | 103.04M | $0.00 cache savings | $0.00 est USD
findings.suspected_source: Pricing table in Cost calculation backend missing entry for model ID 'us.anthropic.claude-fable-5'; possibly a newer/renamed model not yet added to the pricing map.

findings.summary: Switching from Fast (DynamoDB) to Full (Athena) view silently drops the 'untagged' row (2.64M tokens, $329.55), causing KPI totals to drop from $346.70 to $17.15 (95% reduction) with no UI explanation of the scope change.
findings.evidence: screenshots/05-projects-page.png (DynamoDB: 4 projects, 3.25M tokens, $346.70) vs screenshots/10-projects-athena-loaded.png (Athena: 3 projects, 610k tokens, $17.15)
findings.suspected_source: Athena query only returns tagged projects (requestMetadata tag present); untagged traffic excluded from Athena view without a warning banner or note explaining the omission.

findings.summary: Cost center column displays '—' for all projects in Fast (DynamoDB) view; only populated in Full (Athena) view. No tooltip or label indicating cost center data requires the Athena query.
findings.evidence: screenshots/05-projects-page.png (DynamoDB: all cost centers show —) vs screenshots/10-projects-athena-loaded.png (Athena: CC-1001, CC-2002, CC-3003 shown)
findings.suspected_source: Cost center data stored only in Athena/project mapping CSV, not replicated to DynamoDB fast path. UI should indicate column unavailability in fast mode.
